description:
At Hali, your rent includes Virgin Media WiFi and TV, complimentary wellness classes, premium resident amenities and exclusive community events.

Cherrywood offers the best of connected city living and outdoor lifestyle. Located directly on the Green Line Luas, residents enjoy seamless access to Dublin City Centre while being surrounded by landscaped parks, sports facilities and coastal walks.

Designed around wellbeing, connection and convenience, Hali offers an exceptional range of resident amenities, including:
–   Six resident Club Houses
–   The Sky Gym with panoramic mountain and sea views
–   The Wellness Suite with saunas and studios
–   Dedicated work zones, meeting spaces and focus booths
–   Resident-only events and experiences
–   Six roof terraces and landscaped outdoor spaces with playgrounds

More than just an apartment, Hali is a professionally managed rental community where residents can live, work, relax and connect.

Book a viewing today and discover the Hali lifestyle for yourself.
